description: The caller's own listings on XP, grouped by lifecycle category (active, pending, has_open_bids, awaiting_seller_transfer_proof and more) -- 'show the tickets I'm selling'. Paged per category: each category returns one page with its own pagination totals, has_more marks a further page, and offset pages on or state_category narrows to one category. Requires sign-in and the read:bids scope.

limit.description: Listings per state category, 1-200. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Skip this many within each category. Use with limit to page.

state_category.description: Optional: active, pending, has_open_bids, awaiting_seller_transfer_proof, needs_user_attention, ready_to_claim, rejected_bids, terminal.

name: list_my_listings
title: List My Listings
